lines.trans: Viktor Petrovich, why did you call me here?
Good morning, Vika! I have a surprise for you.
I finally came up with an absolutely new restaurant menu.
Really new? Show me your fresh ideas.
Taste this soup, it is a real culinary masterpiece!
Wait, this is your usual old soup after all.
But I added very tasty spices here!
And is this your usual fish from the past menu?
No, this is a special French dish from the chef!
You simply changed old names to new ones!
Does that not sound magnificent for the guests?
You will not be able to stop these important changes.

examples.trans: The bread rings are very tasty.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

meanings.note: at home, a party, or a restaurant

examples.trans: All the guests love them very much.

examples.text: Сегодня вечером к нам придут гости.
examples.trans: Guests are coming to our place tonight.

examples.text: Настроение у меня действительно очень хорошее.
examples.trans: My mood really is very good.
This is indeed an important question.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: to put in as an addition
in greetings: добрый день, добрый вечер
adds emphasis to the word before it
+ genitive: 'из мэрии' = from the town hall

изменить.gloss: to cheat on, to betray; to change

meanings.en: to cheat on, to be unfaithful to

examples.trans: Edik, I wanted to cheat on you.

meanings.note: connected with cooking or the kitchen
on a phone or in a restaurant; indeclinable

examples.trans: The programme is on the website.
He is running for a second term.

meanings.en: name, title (of an object, place, or dish)

examples.trans: I wrote the name on a piece of paper.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

examples.text: Да нет на него никакого компромата. Обычный мужик.
examples.trans: There is no compromising material on him at all. Just an ordinary guy.
There is special attention on the election.
I love our town very much.

examples.text: Все перемены в нашей жизни к лучшему.
examples.trans: All changes in our life are for the better.

examples.text: Дядя Аркадий всё починит и позовёт.
examples.trans: Uncle Arkady will fix everything and call you.
Shall we show this to Anikeev?

meanings.en: to try, to taste (food or drink)

examples.trans: Try the tea with bread rings.

придумать.gloss: to think up, to come up with

meanings.en: to think up, to invent, to come up with

examples.trans: You came up with this yourself!

examples.text: В прошлый раз я думала, война началась.
examples.trans: Last time I thought a war had started.

examples.text: Разве ты не знал об этом?
Слушай, Нина, это же тот самый ресторан!
examples.trans: Listen, Nina, this is that very restaurant!

examples.text: Мы рады видеть вас в нашем ресторане.
examples.trans: We are glad to see you in our restaurant.
A big platter of fish and crabs.

examples.text: На ужин мы приготовили свежую рыбу.
examples.trans: For dinner we cooked fresh fish.

meanings.en: to be able to, to manage to

examples.trans: We came as soon as we could.
Will you be able to come tomorrow morning?
You put in the right spices.
Add some spices to the soup.

examples.text: Я бы на твоём месте подумал.
examples.trans: If I were you, I'd think about it.
